name: @openclinxr/factory-station-core
purpose: Accessor-digest reader trace: binding-traced MISLABELLED analysis for post-export-stage accessor-digest rows.

exportSummaries.REASON_BYTES: Whole live bytes compared to a stored buffer.
exportSummaries.REASON_EMPTY_MAP: Data row maps to no readers.
exportSummaries.REASON_PIN: Whole live-GLB value compared to a stored pin.
exportSummaries.REASON_SIDECAR: Live GLB hash compared to a sidecar pin.
exportSummaries.ReaderCompare: One LIVE whole-GLB value compared to a STORED pin, with its source line.
exportSummaries.ReaderVerdict: MISLABELLED verdict for one accessor-digest row against one reader file.
exportSummaries.assessDataRow: MISLABELLED verdict for a data row's reader mapping ([] and unmapped fail closed).
exportSummaries.assessReader: MISLABELLED verdict for a row file plus field against one reader file.
exportSummaries.assessReaderCompares: Every flagged comparison for a row file plus field against one reader file.
exportSummaries.mapProblem: Names the data basename when a DATA_READERS-mapped reader never mentions it.
